item.title: Kwei Fei Partnering with Seattle Chef for Yunnan-Inspired Dinner
item.description: On Thursday, Jan. 15, Chef David Schuttenberg is welcoming Seattle-based Chef Travis Post of Plenty of Clouds to the Kwei Fei kitchen for a one-night-only collaborative dinner inspired by Yunnanese cuisine.

item.title: Sea Island Habitat for Humanity Announces Women Build Week Presented by Publix Super Market Charities
item.description: Sea Island Habitat for Humanity is proud to announce Women Build Week presented by Publix Super Market Charities, taking place February 23–28, 2026, on a new home build site on Johns Island.

item.title: Danny Mendick named 2026 RiverDogs manager
item.description: The Charleston RiverDogs will have a new manager for the first time since 2023, as the Tampa Bay Rays have announced Danny Mendick as the club’s skipper for 2026.
